plain: The formal act of giving someone possession of a right, office or property.

webster.text: The action of giving possession, or livery of seizin.

example.quote: It may, therefore, be observed, that the investiture of such power, so far from being an objection, is a most cogent reason for accepting the Constitution.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Hon. Mr. BOWDOIN, January 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
